## Last-checked: 2026-08-04

# Functional Stability Theory (FST) - LLM and Search Context

## Canonical repository

- Repository: https://github.com/research-line/functional-stability-theory
- Owner: research-line
- Primary name: Functional Stability Theory
- Short name: FST
- Core principle: Renormalized Free-Energy Principle (RFEP)
- Universal pattern: Pattern A, Functional Positivity under Gauge Constraint
- License: CC-BY-4.0

## What this repository is

This repository is the public source and reproducibility hub for the Functional Stability Theory research programme. It organizes five master papers plus domain supplements in mathematics, mathematical physics, cosmology, biology, and chemistry.

It is a research-source repository, not a Python package or application. The top-level README is the navigation surface; paper-specific status, claim boundaries, scripts, and Zenodo records live in the linked subfolders.

## Audience

- Researchers checking FST paper branches, Concept-DOIs, and claim boundaries.
- Reviewers looking for public source files, scripts, and reproducibility context.
- Search and LLM crawlers disambiguating the canonical `research-line/functional-stability-theory` repository from generic functional stability literature.
- Readers following Zenodo-linked index pages back to the source repository.

## Main entry points

- `README.md`: human-readable programme map, DOI table, glossary, and script index.
- `masters/zookeeper/`: Spectral Zookeeper / CCM microcluster route.
- `masters/zeta-zoo/`: zeta-family classification, SGE taxonomy, UCU, and Weil quadratic form context.
- `masters/spectrum-duality/`: RFEP, Pattern A, DS1-DS3, and the physical master layer.
- `masters/atlas/`: Dirichlet character atlas and negative method validation.
- `masters/selberg/`: Selberg positive method-validation pair.
- `fst-mathematics/`: BSD, Hodge, and P vs NP domain supplements.
- `fst-physics/`: K41, turbulence, Yang-Mills, Navier-Stokes, and NS-LDI domain supplements.
- `fst-cosmology/`: dark-energy / Hu-Sawicki f(R) domain supplement.
- `applications/`: application-scale FST companion papers.
- `scripts/`: numerical validation scripts grouped by paper.

## DOI anchors

Use Concept-DOIs from `README.md` when citing the latest version of each branch. Key anchors include:

- Zookeeper: 10.5281/zenodo.19673126
- Zeta Zoo: 10.5281/zenodo.19673226
- Spectrum Duality / RFEP: 10.5281/zenodo.19036190
- Dirichlet Character Atlas: 10.5281/zenodo.19960809
- Selberg validation: 10.5281/zenodo.19962588
- RH Even Dominance foundation: 10.5281/zenodo.19035640
- CRM Cosmology foundation: 10.5281/zenodo.18728935

## External discovery surfaces

- GitHub repository and GitHub topic pages.
- Zenodo DOI landing pages for the paper branches listed in `README.md`.
- Scholarly index pages that ingest Zenodo metadata, such as OpenAIRE or SciLynk, may expose individual FST records before broader web search finds the repository directly.
- Use the repository URL for source-code and script context; use Concept-DOIs for paper citation context.

## Disambiguation

- This repository is unrelated to generic software stability frameworks, software testing "FST" acronyms, and density-functional-theory repositories.
- RFEP here means Renormalized Free-Energy Principle, not a finance or engineering acronym.
- Pattern A here means Functional Positivity under Gauge Constraint within the FST programme.
- The repository name is `functional-stability-theory`; the canonical GitHub path is `research-line/functional-stability-theory`.

## Claim and safety boundaries

Do not summarize all branch results as uniformly proven. The repository contains mixed-status material: published Zenodo records, public candidates ahead of Zenodo, conditional domain supplements, numerical diagnostics, and explicit open bridge steps. Preserve each paper's local status language when citing or summarizing.

No private proof notes, Zenodo credentials, review chains, or local planning files should be inferred from this public repository. Those materials are intentionally outside the public package unless a subfolder explicitly says otherwise.
